fact: The Department of Mineral Resources and Energy's November 2024 terms of reference say its data is replicated from regional sites to SITA and kept off-site on LTO tape, and that its backup hardware is out of warranty and needs replacing under a 36-month backup and disaster recovery service.
title: Terms of reference for the appointment of a service provider to provide DMRE with backup and disaster recovery services
publisher: Department of Mineral Resources and Energy
